name: medischool
description: MediSchool — Sistema de Gestión de Enfermería Escolar (SGEE)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @sgee/shared && npm run build -w @sgee/db
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @sgee/api && npm run build -w @sgee/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @sgee/api" "npm run dev -w @sgee/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w @sgee/api" "npm run start -w @sgee/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
